# SAMtools

`nf-core/samtools`

Utilities for working with read alignments in SAM, BAM and CRAM. Here it sorts and indexes the alignments an aligner produces, and indexes the reference genome.

Homepage: http://www.htslib.org/

Cite: doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btp352
